docs.summary: A single drawable sprite: a rectangle into a source texture plus the intrinsic data needed to place and render it (pivot, pixels-per-unit, 9-slice border, cached geometry, optional secondary maps and a polygon outline). It carries no draw mode consumers (`SpriteRenderer`, UI) pick Simple / Sliced / Tiled / Filled per instance, so the same sprite can be drawn several ways.
The source texture this sprite is cut from.
The pixel rectangle inside [`Texture`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Resources.Texture) (bottom-left origin).
Normalized pivot within [`Rect`](#api~Prowl.Scaffold.Rect). (0,0) is bottom-left, (1,1) top-right.
How many source pixels map to one world unit.
9-slice border widths in pixels, ordered (Left, Top, Right, Bottom) to match the UI system. Zero means no border.
Named secondary maps aligned to the same [`Rect`](#api~Prowl.Scaffold.Rect) (e.g. "_NormalMap", "_MaskMap"). Sampled by lit / masked sprite shaders.
Cached mesh positions in local units, pivot-relative (x right, y up, z assumed 0).
Cached UVs (0..1 texture space), parallel to [`Vertices`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Resources.Sprite~Vertices).
Cached triangle indices into [`Vertices`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Resources.Sprite~Vertices).
Polygon outline paths in local units (pivot-relative), one array per closed loop. Produced by the tight-mesh tracer and reusable for a future 2D physics collider. Null for a plain quad sprite.
True if any border edge is non-zero (i.e. the sprite can be 9-sliced).
The sprite's size in world units (rect size divided by pixels-per-unit).
Minimum corner of the local-space geometry bounds (pivot-relative).
Maximum corner of the local-space geometry bounds (pivot-relative).

Builds a simple full-rect quad (two triangles) for this sprite, resolving the texture dimensions from [`Texture`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Resources.Texture). Tight-mesh generation is a separate step that overwrites this geometry.

members.name: BuildTightGeometry
members.signature: public void BuildTightGeometry(SpriteMeshTracer.TracedMesh traced, int textureWidth, int textureHeight)

docs.summary: Replaces this sprite's geometry with a tight silhouette mesh from [`SpriteMeshTracer`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Resources.SpriteMeshTracer). Traced coordinates are in the rect's pixel space (bottom-left origin); they map to pivot-relative local units for the vertices and to atlas UVs. The simplified outline becomes [`PhysicsShape`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Resources.Sprite~PhysicsShape). Falls back to a quad if the traced mesh is degenerate.
Recomputes [`BoundsMin`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Resources.Sprite~BoundsMin)/[`BoundsMax`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Resources.Sprite~BoundsMax) from the current vertices.
